title: A model reply that is not valid JSON is refused outright

reasons: model reply is not valid JSON

note: The raw text is truncated mid-object and cannot be parsed by json.loads. ai.shapes.check_stage7_shapes's _payload_mapping returns exactly the failure 'model reply is not valid JSON: ...' for this shape (hand-verified against the function), which the caller treats as the normal, expected retry-or-refuse path -- never as a caller error and never as a value invented to paper over the parse failure.
